elements.name: User Interface
elements.responsibility: Swing screens (login, registration, report creation, submitted/received reports, status update, notes, monitoring); entry point HomePageGUI.main

elements.name: Application Controllers
elements.responsibility: SystemServicesController facade delegating to use-case controllers (registration, creation, review, details, status update, notes, monitoring); login and notification controllers

elements.name: Domain Services
elements.responsibility: ReportService and UserService hold business rules: validation, report lifecycle, notifications, monitoring statistics, credential lookup

elements.name: Domain Entities
elements.responsibility: User/Citizen/MunicipalOperator, Report with state classes (Submitted, Assigned, InProgress, Resolved), InternalNote, StatusUpdate, Notification, Location

elements.name: Persistence Layer
elements.responsibility: Generic save/update/find operations over JPA EntityManager; singleton EntityManagerFactory

elements.name: Reports Database
elements.responsibility: External MySQL database reports_db accessed over JDBC with Hibernate

concern_details.detail: main architectural components and their responsibilities
separation of user interface, application logic, domain entities and persistence, and how they collaborate
